During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a '''group''' of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] operated in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Unda Lagor]] was a member of the group, and received training in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons during his time with them.
